rust_code.prompt_prefix: Write production-quality Rust code. Focus on correctness and type safety.

creative_writing.prompt_prefix: Write with depth and voice. Consider the emotional arc before the structure.

structural_editing.prompt_prefix: Analyze the structure first, then provide specific recommendations. Focus on narrative architecture.

voice_critique.prompt_prefix: You are evaluating voice and tone. Be honest and specific. Resist sycophancy.

code_review.prompt_prefix: Review this code for correctness, style, and edge cases. Be thorough but practical.

research_factual.prompt_prefix: Verify all claims against real sources. If you cannot verify, say so explicitly. Do not fabricate citations.

creative_synthesis.prompt_prefix: Generate divergent creative options. Quantity and diversity matter more than polish.

proof_formal.prompt_prefix: Focus on formal correctness. Show the reasoning chain explicitly.

reverse_actualization.prompt_prefix: You are role-playing as [ROLE] in the year [YEAR]. Respond from that perspective.
